lines.trans: Wait, let's just pay you money.
Bargaining is completely inappropriate here, young man.
But this is a very expensive restaurant!
I know this fine restaurant perfectly well.
The administrator will throw you out into the street immediately.
In a decent suit nobody will recognize me.
And what if you accidentally ruin someone else's clothes?
I promise to behave extremely neatly.
Where exactly are our missing truffles hidden?
You will receive the truffles right after lunch.
The Chef will get very angry if he finds out the truth.
Then wish me bon appétit, Konstantin.
